reviewSection.counter: visible groups plus individual ungrouped findings and recovery items
reviewSection.staleSuggestions: removed when the editor text no longer matches the analyzed source

comparison.legacyCompareBeforeApply: ignored, Ajustar código always follows the ordinary safe apply path
comparison.target: confirmed submit control named wpDiff under the native editform, with id wpDiff or inside wpDiffWidget
comparison.disabledNativeControl: shortcut remains disabled across analysis and Undo busy-state resets

parameterGroups.display: one group with exact remaining occurrence count
parameterGroups.coveredWarnings: only exact native producer strings in the local warning domain
parameterGroups.coverageBinding: complete current text, valid offsets, exact source snippet and confirmed producer identity
parameterGroups.ignoredGroup: equivalent raw warnings stay ignored for that same analyzed source
parameterGroups.unstructuredProposals: remain separate even when labels match
